question: The Khangchendzonga Biosphere Reserve is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khangchendzonga Biosphere Reserve** is located in **Sikkim.**
 
• It is named after the Khangchendzonga mountain range, which is the** third highest peak **in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The reserve covers an area of **2,619 square kilometers** and includes a range of ecosystems, from **subtropical forests to alpine tundra. **
 
• It is home to a variety of rare and endangered species, including the **snow leopard, red panda, and Himalayan tahr.**
 
• The reserve is also important for **local communities,** who rely on its natural resources for their livelihoods.
